title: Upgrade commons-text to fix CVE-2022-42889 (Text4Shell)
description: The dependency scan of trade-intake reports Apache Commons Text 1.9. Versions 1.5 to 1.9 enable the script, dns and url lookups in variable interpolation by default, so untrusted input passed to the interpolator can lead to remote code execution. Version 1.10.0 disables these lookups by default.
acceptance_criteria: org.apache.commons:commons-text is at version 1.10.0 in pom.xml
The dependency scan no longer reports CVE-2022-42889
The dependency scan reports no new findings compared with the scan before the change
No files under src/test are changed
No other dependencies are added, removed or changed
